fixtures.source: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/browsers';const pw=await import('/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/package/index.mjs');const results=[];for(const engine of ['chromium','firefox','webkit']){const browser=await pw[engine].launch(engine==='chromium'?{executablePath:'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome',headless:true}:{headless:true});try{const page=await browser.newPage();const cases=await page.evaluate(()=>{const results=[];for(const [name,aAttrs,bAttrs]of[['empty required','required',''],['selected disabled','required','checked disabled'],['required disabled','required disabled',''],['required and selected','required','checked'],['different forms','required','checked form="other"']]){document.body.innerHTML='<form id="main"><input type="radio" name="r" value="a" '+aAttrs+'><input type="radio" name="r" value="b" '+bAttrs+'></form><form id="other"></form>';const form=document.querySelector('form')!,inputs=[...form.querySelectorAll('input')];results.push({name,valid:form.checkValidity(),values:new FormData(form).getAll('r'),controls:inputs.map(input=>({required:input.required,checked:input.checked,disabled:input.disabled,valueMissing:input.validity.valueMissing,willValidate:input.willValidate}))});}return results;});results.push({engine,cases});}finally{await browser.close();}}console.log(JSON.stringify(results,null,2));await Bun.write('/tmp/acme-m10-radio/native-radio-results.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');

limits: The Toolbar delegation protocol is verified with a bare Toolbar owner; actual house Toolbar integration remains M15.
Standalone name coordination covers house Radio/Radio Card controls within the same native form and tree scope.
Real history/autofill and assistive-technology speech remain final acceptance gates.
Switch, Segmented Control, Tabs, internal indicator and Theme Switcher remain M10.
